run_adoption_snapshot.rule: Revisions are non-negative integers. owner_lease and worker_identity are explicit durable-state assessments, not inferred from a PID.

resource_policy.rule: Limits are positive integers and observed counts are non-negative integers.

run_adoption_decision.rule: Only an active run with an owned lease and verified worker identity may be adopted. Missing, stale, unknown, or unverifiable ownership is operator_required and never schedulable.

resource_decision.rule: Capacity exhaustion defers the run; the policy never starts a process or owns a scheduler handle.

errors: Empty run IDs or statuses and boolean, negative, or non-integer revisions are rejected.
Unknown run statuses are not adopted.
A cancelled_pre_commit outcome is never reactivated; already_committed is projected instead of rerun.
Invalid resource limits or observed counts are rejected.

compatibility.additional_output_fields: Consumers ignore fields they do not require.
compatibility.ownership_rule: Only owner_lease=owned and worker_identity=verified may produce adopt.
compatibility.cancellation_rule: cancelled_pre_commit maps to cancelled and already_committed maps to project_completion.
compatibility.scheduling_boundary: The seam returns decisions only; RuntimeService owns lease acquisition, persistence, scheduling, and process handles.
